ns2:course.label: Corrosion of Metals
ns2:course.description: Electrochemistry, thermodynamics, and kinetics of corrosion; behavior of ferrous and nonferrous metals; corrosion rates; corrosion control; cathodic and anodic protection; high-temperature corrosion; corrosion testing; and electrolytic machining methods. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours.
